newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London mixed to firm, IBM up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London mixed to firm, IBM up.

text.p: U.S. stocks were mixed with a slightly firmer bias in Europe on Tuesday, with shares in International Business Machines Corp tracking a rise overnight in New York.
"There is a slight upward bias and the opening in New York looks slightly higher," one trader said.
The Dow industrials ended 4.41 points higher to 8,198.45 while a technology rally pushed the Nasdaq Composite index to its fourth consecutive record close, at 1,605.43.
IBM rose to $106-5/8 from its close of $106-1/4, while Intel Corp slipped $1/4 to $96-1/2, after gaining $3-1/8 in New York.

In the oils, Occidental Petroleum Corp fell $1/2 to $24-1/2, after rebel attacks in Colombia and a damaging landslide ruptured the main pipeline that transports crude to the Caribbean coast port of Covenas.
Occidental said it was losing $3.3 million for every day production was shut-in at the Cano Limon oil field.
In GLOBEX trading, the September S&P futures contracts was off 0.35 to 955.05 and the September U.S. 30-year long bond contract slipped 3/32 to 114-18/32.
